Example Harbour Award

The Example Harbour Trust supports school leavers who want to go on to university.

Eligibility

Applicants need IB 36 points or A-levels AAA.

All applicants also need a SAT score of at least 1400.

Benefits

Selected students receive GBP 3,000 a year.

How to apply

Fill in the online form on this page and upload your documents before the closing date. Shortlisted applicants are invited to an interview with the selection panel, and the results are announced on this page.
